name: mpp
title: MPP
role: Payment rail, carried by HTTP, MCP and A2A.

spec.statement: Internet-Drafts are draft documents valid for a maximum of six months and may be updated, replaced, or obsoleted by other documents at any time.

exclusions.name: credential=permit2
exclusions.note: The profile accepts only the EIP-3009 authorization credential.

exclusions.name: splits
exclusions.note: The draft allows splits only with permit2 credentials.

exclusions.name: evm sessions
exclusions.note: A separate EVM draft, not an option of charge.

deviations.summary: The EIP-3009 nonce is keccak256 of JSON.stringify([id, realm]), as mppx 0.13 derives it, not of abi.encodePacked(id, realm); a credential using the draft's nonce fails with wrong_nonce.
Over MCP, payment errors are tool results with isError and the challenges in _meta, not the JSON-RPC errors the draft maps them to (-32042, -32043, -32602 and -32603).
An unpaid request that gets a 402 also stores a resource.requested event beside the challenge.
A credential whose attempt is reserved or settlement-uncertain gets 409 without a fresh challenge, because a second challenge could lead to a second payment.
With paymentFlow: authorization, the backend runs before the transfer, which the charge intent counts as partial access before payment. The default, upfront, settles first.

gaps.requirement: Each challenge id is single-use (charge intent); two payers can each settle against one challenge
Payment-Receipt only after an on-chain receipt with a matching Transfer log; the gateway trusts the facilitator's settle result
